correctness.rationale: The Weyl-character orbit diagonalization proves the rank equals the number of nonzero ambiguity coefficients. Cyclotomic field disjointness for gcd(p,m)=1 excludes vanishing at every occupied shift and nonzero modulation. At modulation zero, proper prime-cycle supports induce path forests, so any chosen mth-root edge-product sequence can be integrated to a mask. Lam–Leung characterizes all cancellable lengths; the forest converse yields necessity. The explicit F_31 phase assignment has exact cancellation at precisely shifts ±1. The checker verifies 1,898 assignments and the exact certificate; finite tests are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: For a natural sparse coded measurement design, the theorem replaces an exponential search over phase assignments with the computable arithmetic criterion lambda(u) outside the prime-factor semigroup of the alphabet. The per-mask formula quantifies exact linear matrix-recovery loss, not merely failure/nonfailure. The F_31 example exhibits a genuine compositional obstruction: all binary and ternary masks work individually, but some six-phase masks fail. This changes code-alphabet design, and the complete characterization has mathematical content beyond the previously known binary specialization.
